ctx.x: Ronnie West. I didn't see him. We called him Red. I don't know if Red wasn't there either. We called him Red.

Buddy was there. Now Buddy is about 75 or 80 years old. I think he'd been marching for something like 55 years in the streets or more. I think he was the only person who was ever Grand Marshall's wives or something like that. Anyway, I don't see the regular members when I go. Oh no. And they used to come to Munster's too. And I don't see them there. I don't know what happened. They must have fallen out with Munster herself.
